mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical Pretty Good Oscillator breakout beyond three EMA-smoothed true ranges identifies an unusually strong displacement from the local mean; follow the breakout for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict first cross above +3; short on a strict first cross below -3
mechanism.why_distinct: PGO subtracts a fourteen-period close SMA from the current close and normalizes that displacement by a fourteen-period EMA of completed true range before applying the original symmetric three-range breakout. It is not a raw price-average crossover, unnormalized return sum, regression, prior candidate repair, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse volatility-normalized mean-displacement breakouts are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.true_range: max(high-low,abs(high-previous close),abs(low-previous close)) on continuous completed bars
features.mean: causal SMA(14) of continuous completed closes
features.range_scale: causal EMA(14) of true range, reset across gaps and emitted after full warmup
features.event: long when current PGO>3 and immediately prior PGO<=3; short when current PGO<-3 and immediately prior PGO>=-3
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical PGO(14) symmetric three-range breakout under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, EMA initialization, threshold, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Mark Johnson canonical Pretty Good Oscillator convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: PGO=(close-SMA(close,14))/EMA(true range,14); original breakout system long above +3 and short below -3
external_basis.selection_use: published default length, formula, and symmetric breakout thresholds only; no incidence or outcomes
